headline: Starlink and Telefónica Partner to Provide Satellite Internet in Brazil
summary: Starlink and Telefónica formed a partnership in Brazil under the Vivo brand to deliver satellite internet connectivity to up to 50 million residents in uncovered areas.
why: Telefónica is a major global telecommunications provider, and satellite broadband partnerships expand digital infrastructure access in underserved remote markets.

impacts.name: Telefonica SA
impacts.why: Collaborative infrastructure expansion broadens service reach and subscriber potential in remote regions.
